state_change_action.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the load is switched. If a lambda is used the boolean `state` parameter holds the new status.

*See also: [Sigma-Delta Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/sigma_delta_output#example-configuration-entry)*

turn_off_action.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the load is turned off. `turn_on_action` and `turn_off_action` must be configured together.

*See also: [Sigma-Delta Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/sigma_delta_output#example-configuration-entry)*

turn_on_action.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the load is turned on. Can be used to control for example a switch or output component.

*See also: [Sigma-Delta Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/sigma_delta_output#example-configuration-entry)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The cycle interval at which the output is recalculated. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [Sigma-Delta Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/sigma_delta_output#example-configuration-entry)*
